verdict.rationale: The README states the agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests via `gh`, which covers the core of the story. For review safety, write commands ask for approval once per session, destructive commands always ask, and a composer toggle switches between asking and allowing every tool call. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of staging and commit-message authoring (only implied by 'commits'), in-depth docs on the git/PR workflow beyond a single README line, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
